liturgicalName: The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph
keyVerseDR: "And the child grew and waxed strong, full of wisdom: and the grace of God was in him." (Lk 2:40)

level1.title: Jesus Goes to the Temple
level1.story: Mary and Joseph brought Baby Jesus to the Temple. Old Simeon held Jesus and praised God. Anna told everyone about Him.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who was happy to see Jesus?
level1.prayer: Holy Family, bless my family. Amen.

activity.title: People I'm thankful for
activity.intro: Simeon and Anna thanked God for Jesus. Draw people you thank God for.

level2.title: The Presentation
level2.story: Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the Temple in Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord. A holy man named Simeon took the child in his arms and praised God. He said, "Now Thou dost dismiss Thy servant, O Lord," because his eyes had seen the Savior. The prophetess Anna, who was very old, gave thanks and spoke about the child to everyone. The family went home to Nazareth, where Jesus grew strong and full of wisdom.
level2.keyLine: The child grew and waxed strong, full of wisdom.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What did Simeon say about Jesus?
How can your family grow closer to God?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Mary and Joseph, make our home holy. Amen.

activity.title: Thank you, parents
activity.intro: Mary and Joseph cared for Jesus. Make a thank-you certificate for a parent or guardian.
